draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.40, the 248th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 17th of 17 at DE. He went 177th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (248th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 sacks in 2019, 14th of 17 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Buffalo Bills. 87 career games and 49 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 7 (81st percentile), missed tackle rate 3.9% (78th percentile). Weak spots: pressures 4 (19th percentile), sacks 1.0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 edge rusher who played: 1.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
